answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the island queue naming the yarrow that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 4 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Because of that, each extra identity costs 4 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the harbor record publishes exactly who is still on probation. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
